IGUI_DazedCore_TempUnitsTip: How every Dazed mod shows temperatures. Game setting follows Display > Temperature display in the game's own options.
IGUI_DazedCore_PickHelp: Click a building or a structure you built to add it; click it again to remove it.
IGUI_DazedCore_PickLegend: Green: served. Yellow: a click adds it. Blue: a click removes it. Red: out of reach, or served by another.
IGUI_DazedGuide_OptionTip: Shows the Dazed Mod Suite Guide button at the foot of the left sidebar.
IGUI_DazedGuide_CoreStart_Text: The Dazed suite is a family of Build 42 mods built around Dazed Core. This guide shows a tab for every one you have enabled: Power and Power EV, Plumbing, Climate, Dank, Butchery, Cooking, Still, Essentials, Salvage, Pastimes, Defences, Signal, HUD, Armory, Habits, Occupations, Farming, Storm Prep, Air Drops, Trader, Vehicles, Sabers and Hordes. <LINE> <LINE> Most things are built from recipes taught by handbooks and magazines found in the world, then placed like furniture: right-click the item in your inventory and choose Place. <LINE> <LINE> Right-click a placed part to see what it can do. Its menu shows its state, what it needs and why an option is greyed out.
IGUI_DazedGuide_CoreHeavy_Text: Anything over 30 kg is carried as parts, like a bed or shelving: a Workshop Tracking Array comes as (1/2) and (2/2). <LINE> <LINE> To place it you need every part on you. The parts go back together when it lands, and come apart again when you pick it up.
IGUI_DazedGuide_CorePresets_Text: In the sandbox options the Dazed Core page has one Preset setting: Custom, Easy, Standard, Realistic or Hardcore. <LINE> <LINE> Custom uses each mod's own settings. The others set them all at once: output, battery size, ageing, lightning, cable cost, link reach and the water main.
IGUI_DazedGuide_CorePicker_Text: A transformer or a water main can serve whole buildings. Choose them with the Building Picker: green is served, yellow adds on a click, blue removes on a click, red is out of reach. <LINE> <LINE> Inside a served building the lights and appliances (or the taps and fixtures) work as if the town supply were still on.
IGUI_DazedGuide_PowerStart_Text: A system is a charge controller, at least one battery bank and something that makes power, joined by cables. <LINE> <LINE> 1. Place a solar array outdoors under open sky, facing south for the most power. 2. Place a battery bank, right-click it, Dazed Power, Batteries, and drag car batteries onto its bays. 3. Place a controller. 4. Right-click each part, Dazed Power, Run cable from here, then right-click the controller and Connect it. <LINE> <LINE> Right-click the controller, Dazed Power, Switch on. System monitor opens the charge board: what comes in, what goes out and the battery charge.
IGUI_DazedGuide_PowerWiring_Text: A cable costs Electric Wire by length: one wire per 4 tiles by default. Cutting a cable gives half of it back. <LINE> <LINE> Wiring a live system can burn your hand. Switch the controller off before you connect or cut. <LINE> <LINE> A Makeshift controller manages 8 parts, a Workshop one 24. Transformers carry power across town and can wire whole buildings.
IGUI_DazedGuide_PowerMonitor_Text: Right-click the controller, Dazed Power, System monitor to open the charge board. The SOURCES IN and LOAD OUT dials show what comes in and goes out, NET the difference, and the battery column the charge with its floor as a red line. <LINE> <LINE> BANK shows each cell, RECEIVED TODAY the day's history, and CIRCUITS what is drawing power. The big red MAIN ISOLATOR is the switch. The generator card runs the propane and petrol generators: MASTER, AUTO, ON, and the START BELOW and STOP ABOVE levels. <LINE> <LINE> A wall power gauge cabled to any part shows the charge band and opens the same board, read only.
IGUI_DazedGuide_PowerBatteries_Text: Banks hold car batteries: floor racks 3, 6 or 8, wall boxes 2, 3 or 4. Cold weather lowers what they hold. <LINE> <LINE> When the charge reaches the floor the low-voltage disconnect cuts the load to save the batteries; it closes again when they recharge. <LINE> <LINE> Every charge cycle wears a cell a little for good. A worn cell shows a line under its health bar: equalising can't lift it past that line, so swap it out.
IGUI_DazedGuide_PowerSources_Text: Solar arrays follow the sun and suffer snow and dirt; tracking arrays turn to follow it. The Large Solar Array is four panels on one 2x2 frame. Windmills follow the wind, and a windsock and weather vane let you read it. <LINE> <LINE> Pedal generators make power while you ride. Steam engines burn fuel and need water. Propane, petrol and wood gas generators run from the GEN page and can start and stop on their own at the levels you set. Wood gas burns logs and planks, warms up for a few minutes and needs its ash cleaned out. <LINE> <LINE> A micro-hydro wheel beside a river or lake gives a steady 350 W in any weather, slower in a freeze. A parked car with its engine running feeds up to 500 W through its alternator.
IGUI_DazedGuide_PowerLoads_Text: Lights and appliances in wired buildings draw from the system. So do machines wired to it, like Plumbing's pumps, purifier, fuel pump and well, Cooking's food dehydrator, an electric still, and Dank's grow lights, fans, heaters, air conditioners, humidifiers and pumps. <LINE> <LINE> Right-click the controller, Load Priority: as the batteries run down, Low machines are cut first, then Normal. Essential ones keep running until the low-voltage disconnect.
IGUI_DazedGuide_PowerCharging_Text: Wire a Battery Charger Bench to a controller and right-click it to charge loose car batteries and small batteries from the bank. <LINE> <LINE> To charge a parked car, right-click it while a wired part stands within 10 tiles.
IGUI_DazedGuide_PowerHazards_Text: A thunderstorm can trip the isolator; reset it from the controller. Rarely a strike also damages the controller. A grounding rod within 6 tiles of the controller takes the strike instead. <LINE> <LINE> A Makeshift bank charged hard in a closed room builds up gas. You get a warning first: open a window, or the gas can catch fire.
IGUI_DazedGuide_PlumbStart_Text: There are 18 tanks, small, large and extra-large, for water, propane or petrol, in a Salvaged and a welded Crafted tier. Pipes join tanks and machines into one network; different fluids never mix and each has its colour: water blue, propane white, petrol red. <LINE> <LINE> Right-click a machine and choose its line, then Pipe to a tank. Runs that meet join with T-branches. Valves let you shut a line. Indoors pipes run overhead; outdoors they lie on the ground and wear under zombies and vehicles, so mend them. <LINE> <LINE> A damaged tank leaks, even while you are away. Propane and petrol tanks explode and burn if fire gets too close.
IGUI_DazedGuide_PlumbPumps_Text: A hand pump or an electric pump on open ground fills a water tank from the ground water. The electric one needs power. <LINE> <LINE> A Drilled Well, wired to a powered Dazed Power controller, pumps about 15 L of clean water a minute into its tank.
IGUI_DazedGuide_PlumbQuality_Text: Ground water from a hand or electric pump is dirty. Rain, roof runoff, downspouts and the drilled well give clean water. A purifier on the line cleans whatever passes through it into a tank. <LINE> <LINE> A tank counts as tainted once a tenth of its water is dirty. Its gauge window shows its water quality, level, and what feeds and draws from it.
IGUI_DazedGuide_PlumbRain_Text: Open-topped tanks catch rain. A barrel beside a building catches its roof runoff. A downspout on a wall feeds a tank from the whole roof, up to its cap. Vanilla rain barrels can be piped in too.
IGUI_DazedGuide_PlumbMain_Text: Stand a Water Main outdoors within reach of a house and pick the building. Once the town water is off, every sink, bath, shower, toilet and washer inside is fed from the tank. <LINE> <LINE> Right-click a connected main to open the water panel (see Water panel).
IGUI_DazedGuide_PlumbFuel_Text: Pipe a fuel pump to a petrol tank to refuel a parked car within 2 squares or fill petrol cans. The hand pump is slow; the electric one needs Dazed Power.
IGUI_DazedGuide_PlumbDigester_Text: Feed a digester rotten food and manure and pipe it to a propane tank. It makes gas slowly, slower in the cold, and stops below freezing.
IGUI_DazedGuide_PlumbSprinkler_Text: A garden sprinkler piped to a water tank waters thirsty crops within 3 squares. <LINE> <LINE> Right-click it, Schedule, to water only at dawn, in the evening or at night, and to skip watering while it rains.
IGUI_DazedGuide_ButchStart_Text: Dazed Butchery replaces one-click butchering for cows, pigs, sheep, deer, chickens, turkeys and rabbits. You pick a primal from a diagram of the carcass and trace the cut yourself. <LINE> <LINE> Large animals go on a butcher hook. Bleed them first with the vanilla Bleed button (an unbled carcass caps every grade at 75), then press Open Butchery. Small animals use the vanilla Butcher option, which now opens the Butchery window. <LINE> <LINE> Skin or pluck first: until the hide is off, the whole body is one target.
IGUI_DazedGuide_ButchCut_Text: Pick a primal and press Cut. Hold the left button on the green marker, drag along the line and let go on the red marker. The white dot is your knife: it wanders, so steer it. Rushing makes it wander more. <LINE> <LINE> Let go to pause, then press near where you stopped to carry on. Right-click gives up. <LINE> <LINE> Holding on past the red marker cuts into the neighbouring primal, which lowers its grade cap and yield. <LINE> <LINE> Knife cuts need a knife, saw cuts a saw, cleaver cuts a meat cleaver or hatchet. A worn tool lowers grades and wanders more.
IGUI_DazedGuide_ButchGrades_Text: Every cut lands in your inventory with a hidden grade. At Butchering 2 you see its tier (Prime, Choice, Select, Standard, Poor); at Butchering 6 you see the number. <LINE> <LINE> Grades fall with a slow, unbled or stale carcass, a dull or worn tool and overcuts. Head, blood and bones stay vanilla: take the head on the hook and get bones from the skeleton when you are done. <LINE> <LINE> Dry-aging: a Choice or Prime cut kept in a fridge for a day or more can be trimmed with a knife for a better grade.
IGUI_DazedGuide_ButchField_Text: A large animal on the ground can be Field Dressed with a knife for its offal and twice the freshness, then Quartered with a saw. <LINE> <LINE> Right-click a quarter to Open Butchery on it. Carried by hand, in a bag or loose in a vehicle, quarters bruise and lose grade as you travel. <LINE> <LINE> Drag them on a Butcher's Hand Sled or hang them on a Game Cart (built from a kit and towed by any vehicle) and they keep their grade and spoil more slowly. Cold keeps meat: carcasses and quarters spoil by the temperature around them, and with Dazed Climate a deer hung outside in winter keeps for days.
IGUI_DazedGuide_ButchEdge_Text: Knives, cleavers and saws carry a butcher's edge. Each cut dulls it a little, and a dull edge makes the knife drift more. <LINE> <LINE> Right-click the tool and choose Hone Butcher's Edge with a whetstone. It only affects butchering; vanilla sharpness is untouched.
IGUI_DazedGuide_CookStart_Text: Dazed Cooking gives every cut a best way to cook it and a best doneness. Raw cuts say what they want in their tooltip, for example Best: Grilled / Pan-seared, Medium rare - Medium. There are nine kinds of cut: steak, roast, slow, ribs, chop, pork roast, poultry, offal and wild. <LINE> <LINE> Cook in a stove or oven, on a barbecue, campfire or fireplace, or in a smoker. Once it counts as cooked, the tooltip shows the doneness live: Rare, Medium rare, Medium, Well done, Burnt. <LINE> <LINE> Take it out at the right moment. The dish is named for how it was made, for example Grilled Ribeye Steak (Choice, Medium rare). With Dazed Climate, hot food eaten somewhere colder than 12 C warms you for up to an hour.
IGUI_DazedGuide_CookMood_Text: A cut cooked the right way to the right doneness lifts your mood and eases boredom and stress. With Dazed Butchery the grade multiplies it: a Prime cut done right is the best meal you can have. <LINE> <LINE> A microwaved or burnt cut leaves you a little unhappy.
IGUI_DazedGuide_CookPortion_Text: With Dazed Butchery, right-click a raw primal with a knife to portion it: a Beef Rib becomes three Ribeye Steaks, a Pork Loin four Loin Chops, a Venison Backstrap four Medallions. <LINE> <LINE> Portions keep the primal's food value, age and grade.
IGUI_DazedGuide_DankStart_Text: Cannabis is a farm crop: plow a plot, sow a seed with the vanilla Sow Seed menu, water it and harvest it when ripe. It grows through five stages: seedling, vegetative, pre-flower, flowering and ripe. <LINE> <LINE> Seeds are male or female. Below Agriculture 3 a seed is just Unknown cannabis seed; from 3 Inspect Seed shows its type and sex. Right-click a plant and Inspect it to see what your Agriculture level allows. <LINE> <LINE> Plant a male beside a flowering female and she sets seed. Seeds carry a strain, and crossing two strains makes a new one.
IGUI_DazedGuide_DankLights_Text: Indoors a plant needs light. Grow lamps hang from the ceiling over a free indoor floor square; flood lights stand on a tripod indoors or out. Lamps need power. <LINE> <LINE> A lamp with no timer runs 24/0 and holds plants in veg. Fit a light timer, then switch it between 18/6 (veg) and 12/12 (flower). A plant only moves on to flower under 12/12, and extra veg days add yield. <LINE> <LINE> Light reaching a 12/12 plant in its dark hours is a light leak: it stops the flip and adds stress.
IGUI_DazedGuide_DankBags_Text: Grow bags are placed like furniture and become plots. Fill a new bag with soil once; it keeps its soil through every harvest. XL bags and XL DWC buckets are mother pots. A drip tank keeps soil pots evenly watered. <LINE> <LINE> Feed Veg nutrients in veg and Bloom nutrients in flower. Feeding twice in one stage burns the plant. Strip Fan Leaves in late veg and early flower for better buds, but strip too often and the plant suffers. <LINE> <LINE> Top Plant in veg for more buds, and Take Cutting from a veg or pre-flower plant to clone it. Clones keep their mother's genetics with a little drift each generation.
IGUI_DazedGuide_DankHydro_Text: DWC bucket: one plant drinking from its own reservoir. RDWC: a control bucket with up to 6 site buckets sharing one big reservoir. Ebb and Flow: flood tables fed by a flood reservoir, flooded by hand or by a flood timer. <LINE> <LINE> Sites take a rockwool cube or clay pebbles. Use the Reservoir menu to Top Up, Change, dose nutrients and treat root rot with bleach. Pumps need power; a stale, tainted or unpowered reservoir starts root rot. <LINE> <LINE> With Dazed Plumbing, a reservoir can be piped to a water tank. The line fills a new reservoir, refills one after Change Reservoir, and fills it again when you choose Top Up.
IGUI_DazedGuide_DankRooms_Text: Seal a room with walls, doors and windows and place a Grow Room Panel on a wall. Right-click it to open the room's dashboard: mode, light schedule, temperature and humidity, the room seal, plants, reservoirs, equipment and the log. <LINE> <LINE> Every lamp in the room follows the panel's schedule. The reservoir controls work on every reservoir at once. If the panel loses power, lamps and equipment stop. <LINE> <LINE> Open doors and uncovered windows leak light in the dark hours, and a closed door seeps a little. Hang a vanilla sheet on a door or window and draw it shut to seal it.
IGUI_DazedGuide_DankClimate_Text: A grow room has a temperature and humidity with targets for Veg, Flower and Drying. Sealed rooms run warm, lamps add heat, and plants outside their range are stressed. Humid air risks mold on flowering plants. <LINE> <LINE> Exhaust and intake fans move air: full strength on an outside wall, a quarter on an inside wall. Heaters, dehumidifiers and humidifiers hang high on a wall. On the dashboard, click an Equipment tile to set that kind to Auto, Always on or Off, or to show the units in the room.
IGUI_DazedGuide_DankDrying_Text: Hang wet plants on a drying rack. They dry in about 48 hours; warmth and a powered drying fan speed it up and cut mold. Leave them too long and they over-dry. Damp and rain bring mold. <LINE> <LINE> Trim Plant with scissors or a sharp knife to get buds named by quality. Cure buds in a curing jar or barrel for up to +10% quality, and burp it about every day and a half or mold may spread. Fan leaves dry and cure into hemp wraps. Vanilla dried tobacco cures in a jar or barrel too.
IGUI_DazedGuide_DankSmoking_Text: Roll Joint with rolling papers, Smoke in Pipe with a pipe and a lighter, or Roll Blunt in a hemp wrap or a tobacco leaf. A blunt lasts three sessions: put it out and relight it later. A pipe hit is stronger and builds tolerance faster. <LINE> <LINE> Indica relaxes and makes you hungry and tired. Sativa lifts boredom and mood. Hybrid sits between. <LINE> <LINE> Tolerance makes each dose weaker and fades over weeks off. Regular use builds dependency, and a dependent player goes into withdrawal after about a day without.

IGUI_DazedCore_ClearDone: Cleared {1} zombies, {2} vehicles, {3} placed objects and {4} ground items within {5} tiles

IGUI_DazedControl_PickHint: Dazed Control: click a spot on the map
IGUI_DazedControl_PickFailed: The map did not give a spot
IGUI_DazedControl_NoMap: The world map is turned off on this server

IGUI_DazedGuide_CoreOptions_Text: Every Dazed tick box and key lives under one Dazed Core entry in the Mods options tab. The Temperatures choice (game setting, Celsius or Fahrenheit) is followed by Climate, Dank, the EVs and the thermometer. The Guide button in the sidebar can be switched off there. <LINE> <LINE> A Dazed feature steps aside when another mod you run already does the same job. The server decides every action, and a line above your head tells you why something was refused. <LINE> <LINE> In debug mode or for server staff, a Dazed debug right-click menu spawns a mod's whole item set for testing.
IGUI_DazedGuide_PowerMuscle_Text: Treadmill generator: wire a gym treadmill to a controller and walk, run or sprint on it. Fitness 0 to 10 makes 50 to 150 W walking, double running and 3.5 times sprinting. Sprinting tires you. <LINE> <LINE> Zombie treadwheel (2x2): knock a zombie down, tie it with a rope, lead it home and put it in the wheel, where it walks for ever: about 80 W, 140 W while someone stands close. Running on a taut rope can snap it.
IGUI_DazedGuide_PowerExtras_Text: The electric fence stuns zombies, never people. The room cooler keeps a whole room's food like a fridge. The space heater warms its room and the box fan (60 W) pushes a hot room's air out, both with Dazed Climate. Switch each on from its menu. <LINE> <LINE> Wall gauges show the charge, solar lamps light the yard, and the Knox County Almanac reads the sky for a month of weather. Dazed Dank's grow gear and Dazed Cooking's dehydrator can be cabled in as loads.
IGUI_DazedGuide_PlumbPanel_Text: Right-click a connected water main to open the water panel: supply and demand dials, the house's line rate, every tank and source on the line, per-fixture valves and fill order, and a main shut-off with an optional drain. A wall panel hung inside opens it from indoors. <LINE> <LINE> A tap pipes a single fixture straight to a tank. Tainted water stays tainted.
IGUI_DazedGuide_PlumbSmoker_Text: A propane-fired drum that smokes raw meat and fish in 8 hours, so it keeps six times longer. Pipe it to a propane tank. <LINE> <LINE> With Dazed Butchery and Dazed Cooking it smokes Butchery cuts and dries jerky strips.
IGUI_DazedGuide_PlumbFreeze_Text: With Dazed Climate, water pipes freeze in about 3 hours at -5 C and pass nothing until they thaw. Pipe Insulation Wrap slows that fourfold. <LINE> <LINE> Tanks freeze too, slower the bigger they are. A tank that freezes over 80% full may crack and leak once thawed until you weld it. Petrol and propane never freeze.
IGUI_DazedGuide_DankViewpoint_Text: If you also run Project Viewpoint (the first-person view mod), Dank ships its own 3D models for it: the grow-room furniture, lamps, racks, tables, bags, pots, wall units and every plant in all its stages and conditions. <LINE> <LINE> They load only when Viewpoint is on. Without it Dank looks as it always did.
IGUI_DazedGuide_DankPower_Text: With Dazed Power, grow lights, room fans, heaters, air conditioners, (de)humidifiers, hydro and drip pumps and the drying fan can be cabled to a controller or transformer as loads. They show on the LOADS page and in Load Priority, and go dark when cut. Gear you do not cable keeps running off any powered square. <LINE> <LINE> The Dank: Garden Crops add-on lets 55 vanilla crops grow in grow bags, and 37 of them in hydro. Fill the bag with potting soil first. Root, bulb, sprawling and grain crops need soil, so hydro refuses them. In hydro a plant drinks from the reservoir and grows a little faster.
IGUI_DazedGuide_ButchRender_Text: Render fat: chop fat into a cooking pot, cook it on any stove, campfire or barbecue, then Strain Rendered Fat. Suet gives 3 tallow, pork fat gives 3 lard and 2 cracklings. Tallow or lard makes tallow candles and lye soap. <LINE> <LINE> Cuts also become mince, cured bacon, cured ham, sausages, jerky, bone meal and blood-and-bone fertilizer, and their grades carry over. Curing and Smoking Quarterly teaches the cures. Jerky needs drying with Dazed Cooking. <LINE> <LINE> The Butcher's Log keeps your cuts, Prime cuts, overcuts and best grade per animal.
IGUI_DazedGuide_CookWindow_Text: Right-click a pot, pan, bowl, a stove, oven, grill, fire or a drying rack and choose Open Cooking Window, or bind a key in the Mods options. <LINE> <LINE> Cook picks a dish and a pot in reach and shows every ingredient nearby with its Butchery grade. On the Heat lists everything cooking within 12 tiles, with doneness bars and Take Off. Recipes saves a pot as a named recipe to Cook Again. Drying shows every rack and dehydrator nearby with Load and Collect buttons.
IGUI_DazedGuide_CookDrying_Text: Build a Wooden Drying Rack (Carpentry 2) or a Ground Drying Rack (no skill), place it like furniture and put fresh food in its 20 slots. It dries on its own: greens and mushrooms in 1 day, most fruit and vegetables in 2, juicy fruit in 3. <LINE> <LINE> Dried food weighs a quarter as much, keeps its calories and lasts for months. A Food Dehydrator dries three times as fast and ignores the weather; it needs the grid or a generator, or Dazed Power as a 500 W load. With Dazed Climate, outdoor racks pause in rain, snow and frost.
IGUI_DazedGuide_EVStart_Text: Homemade 1993 electric vehicles for Dazed Power: the Club Cart and Four-Seat Club Cart, the Elec-Trak garden tractor, the Wedge Car (a 70 km/h two-seater), the Ride-On ATV and the rare Five-Wheel Utility Hauler. Find them at well-off houses, trailer parks, farms and junkyards, or build them. <LINE> <LINE> Garage Conversion: right-click one of seven donor cars from outside and pick Convert to electric. It has 10 battery slots, about three quarters of the donor's speed, and keeps its paint, parts, contents and key. Learn it from the Convert It! magazine. Built vehicles roll out with an empty battery tray.
IGUI_DazedGuide_EVBatteries_Text: Car batteries (720 Wh), makeshift batteries (240 Wh) and heavy deep-cycle batteries (1,400 Wh) can be mixed freely; each keeps its own charge and health. An insulated battery box halves the cold's range loss, a pack balancer evens the batteries on charge and a cell meter flags the weak one. <LINE> <LINE> Driving uses charge by distance, more flat out; lights and heater draw too, and cold cuts range. Below 15% the vehicle limps, below 5% it crawls, flat it stalls. The dash shows charge, motor power, heat and your real range.
IGUI_DazedGuide_EVCharging_Text: Build an EV charger (Makeshift 600 W, Salvaged 1,200 W or Workshop 2,400 W), wire it in like the charging bench, park within 4 tiles and choose Plug in charging lead. Any other wired Dazed Power part within 10 tiles works as a 600 W lead. The dash shows the time to full. <LINE> <LINE> Roof arrays fit the club carts, the wedge car and conversions and charge while you drive. The Fold-Out array unfolds to three times the area when parked.
IGUI_DazedGuide_EVTrailers_Text: Every EV has a hitch. Trailers: utility, dump, battery (six more slots joined to the towing EV's pack) and generator (a petrol set that charges the pack as a range extender). <LINE> <LINE> Motors heat up under load: past 100 C they ease off and at 130 C they cut out until they cool. Rare faults are mended from Battery pack, Repair motor. With Dazed Farming Equipment the Elec-Trak takes its mower deck, plough and blade.
IGUI_DazedGuide_ClimStart_Text: Dazed Climate makes winters real. Realism is Kentucky weather: winter days about 5 C, nights about -4 C, cold snaps down to -10 to -20 C. Harsh Reality is a deep northern winter. Pick Vanilla to turn the mod off. <LINE> <LINE> Temperatures swing between night and day, wander day to day and drift through cold snaps and warm spells. Everyone on a server sees the same weather. A Dial Thermometer reads the temperature where you stand, and the emergency broadcast gives today's and tomorrow's temperatures with frost warnings.
IGUI_DazedGuide_ClimRooms_Text: Every room near a player has its own temperature. Brick, stone and log walls hold heat best, plank and siding less, sheet metal hardly at all. Basements stay near 10 C. Open or broken windows and doors let heat out; a barricaded hole much less. <LINE> <LINE> Lit fireplaces and wood stoves, barbecues, a working stove and sun through windows warm a room, greenhouses more. Until the power goes off, houses keep their heating and air conditioning. A room warmer than outside warms you while you stand in it.
IGUI_DazedGuide_ClimCrops_Text: Outdoor crops are hurt below their frost line and killed by an hour of hard frost: tender crops go first (0 C), half-hardy next (-2 C), hardy last (-5 C). Indoor and greenhouse crops are safe. <LINE> <LINE> Right-click a crop to Cover plant against frost with a sheet, tarp or blanket: it stays 4 C warmer. Right-click a farm plot to Put up a row tunnel (a tarp or 3 garbage bags and 3 sticks): the crop is warmer, skips the winter penalties from October to April and keeps growing. Rain can't reach it, so water by hand.
IGUI_DazedGuide_ClimBody_Text: Cold hands and feet build up frostnip, then frostbite, shown in the Health panel. Gloves, boots and wet clothes all matter. Frostnip heals once warm. Frostbite needs warmth and a bandage; left cold it costs a finger or a toe for good. <LINE> <LINE> Food in a room below 15 C ages slower: about fridge speed at 0 to 4 C and hardly at all frozen. A cellar or an unheated room in winter becomes a larder.
IGUI_DazedGuide_StillStart_Text: Learn the recipes from The Home Brewer magazine or by levelling Cooking. In a bucket with 8 L of water, grain and hops make wort, grain makes a grain mash, potatoes a potato mash, sugar a sugar mash and honey a honey must. Press 12 apples or grapes for juice. <LINE> <LINE> Use a Fermenting Bucket (20 L) or a Stoneware Crock (40 L), pour the mash in, right-click and pitch yeast. Wort becomes beer in about 4 days, apple juice cider in 7, other juices wine in 10 and honey mead in 14. 18 to 24 C is ideal; cold slows it and heat risks souring. A hydrometer shows the progress.
IGUI_DazedGuide_StillDistil_Text: Three stills: a Makeshift Still (8 L, wood or electric), a Salvaged Still (40 L, propane or electric) and the two-square Copper Pot Still (60 L, wood, with a thumper). Pour in a wash, add fuel, fill the cooling tub and light it. <LINE> <LINE> Make the cuts yourself on the still panel: foreshots, heads, hearts and tails, or walk away and your Cooking skill makes them. Foreshots are poison and a bad cut gives Bad Moonshine. A still that boils its tub dry can catch fire, and the thumper draws zombies.
IGUI_DazedGuide_StillAge_Text: Char an Oak Ageing Barrel and fill it: moonshine and raw brandy become Whiskey and Brandy in 30 days, raw rum becomes Rum in 20. Proof high-proof spirit down to Vodka. <LINE> <LINE> Add a splash of petrol to make fuel ethanol. Generators take a blend up to 15%, or any blend with an Ethanol Carburettor Kit.
IGUI_DazedGuide_EssPry_Text: Right-click a locked door, garage door or window to pry it open with a crowbar, or right-click a car for Pry open. Hold the left mouse button and keep the needle in the green until the bar fills; run past it and the crowbar slips. Strength widens the green. Every try is loud and tiring, and a pried door can't be locked again until repaired. <LINE> <LINE> No can opener? Open with screwdriver is quiet but can fail and cut your hand; Smash open with a hammer or rock always works but is heard and can spill food.
IGUI_DazedGuide_EssBulk_Text: Right-click near corpse piles for Burn all corpse piles nearby, one lighter use per pile. Right-click rippable clothing for Rip all clothing; yields and XP are the game's own. Worn, held and favourite items are skipped. <LINE> <LINE> Replace dirty bandages swaps every dirty one you wear for a clean one. Soak a dirty bandage or rag in rubbing alcohol or a strong spirit to sterilise it without washing. When an action takes a tool out of a bag, it goes back in once you stop.
IGUI_DazedGuide_EssMirror_Text: Right-click any mirror and choose Remember yourself: it saves every skill's XP and your known recipes and makes that spot your respawn point. After you die the spawn screen offers Your mirror. <LINE> <LINE> At a mirror the new character can Remember your past life: each skill comes back to 80% of the saved XP, once per past life.
IGUI_DazedGuide_EssGear_Text: A flashlight hangs on any belt slot a walkie-talkie fits. One key (set in the Mods options) or a right-click swaps your hands with your back, and a second hotbar slot holds another big weapon on your back. <LINE> <LINE> Duffles, suitcases, coolers and toolboxes hang on a pack's bedroll spot. A bag packed inside another bag you carry gets its own inventory button, 2 levels deep by default.
IGUI_DazedGuide_EssRead_Text: Skill books teach as you read: each new page gives some XP, and a whole book gives 25% of the XP your next level needs. Rereading gives nothing more. <LINE> <LINE> Climb fire escape, railroad, sewer and basement ladders, fire station poles and ladders you build: right-click or press Interact (E) at one. Corpse dragging is faster too. Every feature has its own sandbox switch.
IGUI_DazedGuide_SalvStart_Text: Twenty real parts, each with its own condition: electric motors, a refrigeration compressor, copper tubing, a condenser coil, a fan motor, a thermostat, a heating element, a circuit board, a drive belt, a pressure tank, a small engine, an alternator, a starter motor, a wiring harness, copper wire and more. They turn up in garages, mechanic shelves, generator rooms and appliance stores. <LINE> <LINE> Other Dazed mods accept them as alternative recipe inputs. Copper parts saw into vanilla copper scrap for metalworking.
IGUI_DazedGuide_SalvStrip_Text: Right-click a fridge, freezer, washer, dryer, oven, microwave, AC unit, TV, computer, vending machine or arcade cabinet with a screwdriver (and for most, a wrench) in your bags and choose Strip for Parts. Stoves and microwaves must be switched off and TVs need the tape ejected. <LINE> <LINE> Strip Wire for Copper turns 5 electric wire into 1 copper wire. Strip Generator for Parts turns a vanilla generator into an engine, pull starter, alternator, wire and sheet metal.
IGUI_DazedGuide_SalvCars_Text: With the hood open, the engine off, a screwdriver, a wrench and Mechanics 2, remove a car's starter motor or alternator (the harness too from wrecks), or fit one you carry. No starter or harness and the car won't start; no alternator and the battery drains while it runs. <LINE> <LINE> Scrap Wreck Parts, once per wreck, gives the battery, radio, headlights and tyres, worn. Burnt shells give a handful of parts. A worn-out Dazed Power EV gives up its battery pack.
IGUI_DazedGuide_PastStart_Text: Games for the vanilla dice, cards, chips and boards. Right-click a die to roll it; everyone nearby sees the result above your head. Right-click a table and pick Table games. <LINE> <LINE> Poker is Texas hold'em for up to six: start with a deck of cards, buy in with poker chips and cash out whole chips. Blinds, all-ins and side pots work and nobody sees your cards. High roll and Liar's dice are dice games for two to six.
IGUI_DazedGuide_PastGames_Text: Checkers and Chess follow every rule. Pool: right-click a pool table to play eight-ball against another player or practise alone; aim with the mouse and drag back for power. <LINE> <LINE> Right-click the PAWS pinball machine and the Dr. Oids and Kaboom arcade cabinets to play them; each machine keeps its own top five. Playing eases boredom a little, more with company.
IGUI_DazedGuide_PastStakes_Text: In checkers, chess, pool and the dice games you can put up chips, items or information: a secret note, marks for the winner's map, or a patch of your map to uncover for them. The table holds the stakes and pays the winner. <LINE> <LINE> Onlookers can back a side with chips. Promises go in writing too, but nobody can make you keep them.
IGUI_DazedGuide_DefTraps_Text: Tin-can alarm line: cans on a string that rattle when a zombie touches them and tell you where. Spike pit: dug with a shovel; zombies fall in, take a few stakes and stay down for a few seconds. Nail board: slows and cuts what walks over it and can puncture a vehicle's tyre. <LINE> <LINE> Every trap wears out. Right-click it to see how worn it is, repair it or take it down for part of its materials. Traps don't hurt players unless a sandbox option says so.
IGUI_DazedGuide_DefBrace_Text: Right-click a door from inside and choose Defences, Fit brace brackets (hammer, 4 nails, 1 plank, once per door). Then drop a plank or metal bar into the brackets: it locks the door and takes the hits until it snaps. Lift the brace bar gets it back. <LINE> <LINE> The Reinforced Gate is built from the vanilla build menu (Carpentry, Woodwork 4): planks and sheet metal, 800 health against a wooden gate's 300. It takes the brace bar like a door.
IGUI_DazedGuide_SigMasts_Text: Rooftop antenna, wooden mast, steel mast and lattice tower give 1.5, 2, 4 and 8 times a ham radio's range. Wire a ham radio to a mast close by. The mast needs power from Dazed Power, the grid or a generator. <LINE> <LINE> Steel masts tell you roughly which way a beacon came from; lattice towers add a rough distance.
IGUI_DazedGuide_SigBeacons_Text: Set a message and call sign on a wired ham and send it once or every few hours, perfect for trade posts. Far from the ham a beacon loses letters to static. <LINE> <LINE> A Signal Logger records everything heard on its frequency and anyone who finds it can read it. Scramblers and cipher cards keep a message for the people meant to read it.
IGUI_DazedGuide_SigRelay_Text: Dazed Signal reads other Dazed mods out on the survivor frequency: Defences' perimeter alarm ('Perimeter alarm tripped near x, y') and, with the Extreme Weather mod, its emergency warnings once per storm (an option turns that off).
IGUI_DazedGuide_HudStart_Text: A quiet HUD that shows things only when they matter. Seven segmented meters sit left of the hotbar: health, hunger, thirst, fatigue, endurance, body temperature and calm (green, amber under 45%, red under 20%). A small readout card fades in over a meter when it crosses a line, moves quickly or you hover it. <LINE> <LINE> High, Drunk and Nicotine bars appear right of the hotbar only while they apply. While you aim, a weapon tag shows ammo, spare rounds, the chamber lamp and condition. Each hotbar slot has a thin condition strip.
IGUI_DazedGuide_HudSkin_Text: A slate and olive skin covers the inventory and loot windows, the character info window, the crafting and building windows and the hotbar slots. Nothing is replaced and one option turns each part off at once. <LINE> <LINE> The loot window's container buttons sit on its left edge by default; set the option to Right for vanilla's place.
IGUI_DazedGuide_HudMarks_Text: Once someone has taken something out of a container, a chalk mark (or a Looted / Empty tag) shows by it for everyone. Sandbox sets chalk, tag or off and how many days a mark lasts. <LINE> <LINE> With Power, Plumbing, Still, Signal or Dank installed, a small card appears over a battery rack, tank, fermenter, still, barrel, radio mast, grow plant or grow room panel with its level, progress or warning. Every element is Context, Always or Off in the Mods options.
IGUI_DazedGuide_ArmStart_Text: Realistic BB guns and 25 real guns: handguns, submachine guns, rifles, shotguns, the Ma Deuce .50, an M249 SAW, an M82 .50 rifle, the flare pistol (its flare draws zombies) and a nailer. Each is built on the closest vanilla gun, so it handles, sounds and reloads like it. <LINE> <LINE> Find them in gun stores, pawn shops, hunting spots, homes, and police and SWAT storage; the heavies only in army storage, the .50s very rarely.
IGUI_DazedGuide_ArmAttach_Text: Vanilla scopes, red dots, lasers, gun lights, chokes and recoil pads fit the guns they suit and show on the model. New ones: suppressors (factory, pipe or potato), taped flashlight, shotgun tube extension, bipod, bayonet, starlight night scope and vertical foregrip. <LINE> <LINE> Magazines show only when they are in. Extended magazines and drums exist. Reload the Model 10, SKS or Mozin-Nagant with a loaded speedloader or stripper clip and it all goes in at once.
IGUI_DazedGuide_ArmReload_Text: Spent brass and 12 gauge hulls come back from real guns, more as Reloading grows. Load 9mm, .45, .38, .357, .44 and 12 gauge on a press or a Lea Loader hand kit, and rifle rounds too (.22 LR, 7.62x39, .30-06, .30 Carbine, 7.62x54R, .50 BMG and vanilla ones). <LINE> <LINE> Primers and powder are rare finds and the real limit. .22 LR is re-primed with priming compound and gives more duds; .50 BMG is press only. Learn recipes by skill or from the Handloader's Digest.
IGUI_DazedGuide_HabMeds_Text: Dazed Habits is medicine and what comes after it. Every dose eases something and costs something. Medicines: Codeine, Oxycodone, Diazepam, Methylphenidate and Phenobarbital tablets, cough syrup, morphine, activated charcoal and a Naloxone Syringe, found in cabinets, pharmacies, hospitals and bedrooms. <LINE> <LINE> Each dose rises, holds and fades along a curve. Opioids ease pain and stress and make you drowsy. Sedatives calm panic and tire you. Stimulants keep tiredness away, then leave a crash.
IGUI_DazedGuide_HabStreet_Text: With the sandbox option on, street drugs turn up in drug dens, motels, bars, clubs and police stores: Heroin, Cocaine, Meth, Crack, LSD, MDMA, Psilocybin Mushrooms (also foraged in autumn) and a rare PCP baggie. Right-click to Snort, Smoke or Inject; each route hits differently. <LINE> <LINE> Psychedelics lift mood for hours and can turn into a bad trip. Used syringes can give an infection. You can make some yourself from poppy pods and the recipe magazines, and Cook Crank can go wrong.
IGUI_DazedGuide_HabRisk_Text: Tolerance builds with use and fades when you stop. Regular use builds dependence; stop and you get craving, then withdrawal. <LINE> <LINE> Too much, or the wrong mix with opioids, sedatives, alcohol, sleeping tablets or painkillers, climbs four stages and then an overdose: you go unresponsive and another player has a short window to bring you round with naloxone. Out of time, you die. Eleven moodles of its own, screen tints and hallucinated sounds follow what you took.
IGUI_DazedGuide_OccStart_Text: Dazed Occupations adds 14 starting occupations that line up with the other Dazed mods: Power Plant Operator, EV Technician, Pipefitter, Cultivation Tech, Budtender, Botanist / Breeder, Distiller, Master Butcher, Gunsmith, Radio Operator, Wrecker, Pharmacist, Paramedic and Vet Tech. <LINE> <LINE> An occupation shows on the character screen only while the mod it belongs to is on. Each gives skill boosts and teaches that mod's recipes.
IGUI_DazedGuide_OccTraits_Text: 26 traits plus a few free hidden ones, such as Lineman, Handloader, Brewer, Green Thumb, Butcher's Hands, Pipe Dreams, Wrench Hand and Light Drinker. Like occupations they appear only with their mod. <LINE> <LINE> Some traits take effect only through hooks in the mod they belong to, so a trait can list recipes or skills before its other effects arrive.
IGUI_DazedGuide_FarmTools_Text: The wheel hoe counts as a digging tool and has a Cultivate row option that plows three squares in a line in one action. Carry a seed dibber and sowing takes about a third less time. <LINE> <LINE> The hand broadcast spreader sows up to three connected furrows in one action (about one seed in ten is lost). The seed cleaner saves seed from corn, peas, soybeans and fresh barley, rye and wheat sheaves.
IGUI_DazedGuide_FarmTractors_Text: A small garden tractor and a big red row-crop tractor, both with a rear hitch and rare on farms. The towed plough ploughs a strip three squares wide at walking pace, and crops sown in machine-worked furrows grow 20 percent faster. <LINE> <LINE> The towed seeder is a three-row drill with a 15 seed hopper: fill it, tow it at walking pace and it sows tilled plots as you drive.
IGUI_DazedGuide_FarmImplements_Text: A mower deck, a furrow plough and a front blade bolt onto either tractor, and onto the Elec-Trak from Dazed Power EV. Plans are in the Farm Implements Handbook, found in farm sheds and barns. <LINE> <LINE> The control box beside the dash has switches to lower and raise the implement, switch the seeder on and off and pick its crop. It can be turned off in the options.
IGUI_DazedGuide_StormRadio_Text: Storm Prep reads the Extreme Weather mod's warnings and helps you prepare. It never changes the storms. <LINE> <LINE> Make a Weather Alert Radio from a battery radio, an electric wire, a screwdriver and Electricity 2. Switched on with battery, it shows a bulletin above your head when a storm is warned, starts or passes, with the kind of storm, hours to go and, for a tornado, its direction and EF rating. Drop it on the ground and everyone within 8 tiles gets the bulletin.
IGUI_DazedGuide_StormBoard_Text: 4 planks, 8 nails and a saw make a Boarding Kit. Right-click a window or door and choose Board up (kit): four planks in one action, 20 percent faster during a storm. <LINE> <LINE> Without Dazed Signal, a radio relay puts a line on the survivor frequency when a storm is warned.
IGUI_DazedGuide_DropStart_Text: A plane crosses the map and a sealed crate lands on open ground 150 to 400 tiles from a player. Military drops come every 3 to 5 days while the power grid is up, then rare survivor drops once it is off. <LINE> <LINE> A radio warning a few hours ahead gives a rough circle on the map. Pry the crate open: 6 seconds with a crowbar, 15 with a hammer, 30 by hand. The noise draws attention, and crates vanish after three days.
IGUI_DazedGuide_DropFlares_Text: Red, green, amber and blue signal flares turn up in army, police and gun store loot. Fire one outdoors to call a drop of its colour (military, medical, tools or food). It lands 40 to 120 tiles away in a few hours, one call per player per cooldown, and red flares only work while the power is on. <LINE> <LINE> Military drops are guarded by zombies in army uniforms round the crate; more guards means more loot.
IGUI_DazedGuide_TradeStart_Text: A barter trader travels between seven stops, each a Spiffo's parking lot. He radios a warning a few hours before he arrives, sets up a booth for two to three days and packs up again. Players within 200 tiles see the exact spot. <LINE> <LINE> The booth can't be picked up, scrapped or looted: one strike is a warning, a second strike in the same visit is a ban. He never opens inside a safehouse.
IGUI_DazedGuide_TradeBarter_Text: Trade goods for goods or for Money; change comes back as Money. His stock grows by tier as the server days pass, and good standing opens the next tier early and gives a discount. He wants some things more than others and the Wanted strip shows what he pays. <LINE> <LINE> Armory, Habits, Dank, Salvage and Air Drops goods join his stock when those mods are on.
IGUI_DazedGuide_VehStart_Text: An early test build with plain coloured models while the physics are worked out. The Armored bus has 10 seats and a big luggage bay, found at airports and transit stops, and can be bolted with window cages, side skirts, a ram and a roof rack. The Dash Rattlesnake is a quick V10 roadster and coupe found at sports-car spots. <LINE> <LINE> A bicycle and a motorcycle with a sidecar exist for physics testing and do not spawn.
IGUI_DazedGuide_SabStart_Text: Craft a Scrap Saber from a flashlight, a metal pipe, duct tape, electronics scrap and a battery (Electricity 3, screwdriver). Chrome and Dark hilts are rare finds in pawn shops, army electronics stores and toy crates; five colours of kyber crystal change the blade. <LINE> <LINE> Right-click the hilt to ignite it, or bind a key in the Mods options. It cuts through several zombies per swing and runs on its power cell for about two in-game hours; put in vanilla batteries to recharge. Dismemberment can be tuned or turned off.
IGUI_DazedGuide_HordeStart_Text: Dazed Hordes is still being built. For now it tracks how much attention your base draws (gunfire, generators, night lights, engines, someone living there) and shows a note when your place feels exposed, with a warning icon beside the moodles. <LINE> <LINE> No hordes come yet. Staff get a Hordes tab in Dazed Control.
